text:
Raya (Marketing): Quick thread to finalize the launch post + short webinar deck + inbound routing for leads calling out benchmarks. We need crisp lines vs Cloud providers, LLM API players, and infra vendors. Also want an explicit 'bench request' path.
Evan (Product): Latest numbers in the shared sheet: https://drive.redwood/launch-benchmarks — highlights: 1.8x lower p99 vs CloudY at 6k tokens under typical prefix caching; 25% lower per-token cost vs APIHub when batching and KV cache enabled. Note: measurements use production-ish traffic patterns.
Priya (Content): I'll write the launch post and three social cards. Proposed hero sentence: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower unit-costs across hosted, dedicated, and private deploys." Want a second line that calls out the benchmark without sounding like a number dump. Suggestions?
Noah (Sales Ops): For SDRs, give a 20s opener + two quick rebuttals: Cloud provider managed endpoints and self-hosted infra vendors. Keep it < 2 sentences. Also need a tiny card for CRM when lead mentions 'benchmark' so AE sees it immediately.
Ivy (Growth): Routing rules draft (pseudocode):
```
if contains(leadin.text, "benchmark") or contains(leadin.text, "latency"):
  assign_team = "solutions-eng"
  tags += ["needs-battlecard", "bench-request"]
elif company.size >= 1000 or mention("SLA"):
  assign_team = "enterprise-sales"
  tags += ["high-touch"]
elif intent == "eval" and company.size < 50:
  assign_team = "self-serve-growth"
else:
  assign_team = "nurture"
```
Raya (Marketing): Add an immediate Slack ping to #sales when bench-request tag applied. Also include 'webinar-nurture' sequence for attendees who ask for benchmarks.
LeadRouterBot: Draft rules received; testing route in staging. Will return sample payload.
Evan (Product): Small precision: call the latency number "p99 under typical production caching" in a footnote. For the per-token cost, recommend phrasing: "unit cost savings in common production configs (batching + cache)."
Priya (Content): Draft social copy: "New: predictable latency + consistent unit economics for real-world LLM workloads. See how we compare to CloudY & APIHub in production-style tests." Will attach a short graphic with two callouts: p99 and unit-cost.
CopyBot: Suggested subject lines for email/webinar invite: ["Why latency still matters for LLM UX", "Reduce inference spend without sacrificing latency"].
Noah (Sales Ops): For the CRM card, include fields: 'bench_requested: yes', 'bench_details: free-text', 'assigned_to: solutions-eng'. Also add a quick link to the battlecard one-pager.
Ivy (Growth): We'll add an AB test for two webinar narratives: "Latency-first" vs "Cost-predictability-first" and route registrants differently (platform leads -> latency, procurement -> cost).
Raya (Marketing): Final narrative: lead line = "Predictable latency. Predictable cost." Bench callouts: p99 and unit-cost with short footnotes. Routing: bench requests -> solutions eng + 'needs-battlecard' tag + Slack ping. Action items: @Evan update methodology blurb, @Priya finish post + deck, @Noah add CRM card, @Ivy implement routing + AB test. Deck + one-pager due Wed EOD.
Evan (Product): Will update bench sheet with methodology and quick CSV export for AE.
Priya (Content): Will finish creative and upload slides to the drive tonight.
Noah (Sales Ops): Will create the CRM card template and a sample webhook payload.
LeadRouterBot: Test route executed at 1921012375 in staging. Ready for manual QA.
Raya (Marketing): Thanks everyone. If we spot any competitor claims that feel off, flag in this thread and we'll add a 'claims rebuttal' table to the battlecard. :white_check_mark:
